static_traits.name: Hai Li
static_traits.family_status: The husband is a US Army soldier and is expecting the first child; the father is a missionary
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends, but has not yet shared worries about the relationship with the husband with them
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; without past psychotherapy experience; never had similar psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: High cooperation, clear expression, able to self-reflect; affected by Anxiety, tending toward catastrophizing, mind reading and personalized inferences

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my husband may hate me, because he has stayed Silent since learning I am pregnant, which makes me feel Anxiety and Fear.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because Anxiety and Fear around the relationship with my husband have become hard to bear, affecting my daily life and physical and mental health.
growth_experiences: Family of origin: father is a missionary.
Education and role transition: after High school graduation mainly taking on the Homemaker role.
Marriage and partner background: married to a serviceman husband who is currently in service.

core_beliefs: I will be rejected/disliked by others because of my faults

special_situations.event: The husband has remained silent since learning about my pregnancy
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Silence equals being angry at or disliking me, meaning the relationship has a serious problem
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently trying to communicate with him and repeatedly guessing his thoughts in mind, reinforcing vigilance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He hates me; he does not want this child

special_situations.event: When I brought up the topic of pregnancy, my husband became more distant
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the partner does not respond positively right away, it means he negates me and the child
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding seeking support from friends, bearing Anxiety alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He does not want to be a Father, things are getting worse

special_situations.event: I did not tell my husband about the pregnancy right away
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If major news was not shared in time, it means I did wrong and deserve to be blamed or disliked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame, repeatedly reflecting on one's own faults and attributing problems to oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I did something wrong, so he hates me

special_situations.event: Whenever husband is quiet or seems distant
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he stays Silent, the relationship will inevitably deteriorate in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-focusing on his behaviors, persistent worry and insomnia to try to control uncertainty

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be explicitly accepted, understood, and cherished by her husband; the relationship safe and stable
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected/being disliked; fearing losing the relationship and intimacy breaking
defense_goal: Lowering uncertainty and gaining a sense of control and security through self-blame and preemptively assuming others' intentions

object_relations.self_representation: A guilty and uneasy wife, worrying she 'did wrong'
object_relations.object_representation: A Silent husband who may reject or negate her

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the husband stays silent or seems distant
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing Silence as negation and dislike of herself (transference: projecting the Fear of not being loved onto the other's intentions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, inquiring tone, avoiding asserting the other's intentions; seeking information with 'I'-feeling statements and Clarification questions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing uncertainty (unable to know the husband's true feelings and attitude)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Fills the gaps with catastrophic imagination, believing the relationship will deteriorate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Encourages reality testing and evidence gathering, gradually proposes concrete, verifiable hypotheses and carries out small-step tentative communication.

manifestations: The husband's Silence and distance bringing a sense of not being understood and Sense of isolation
Keeping silent with friends, lacking sharing of external support

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse that should originally be expressed outward or seek others' help, turning the energy onto themselves.
manifestations: Keeping marriage worries from friends, choosing to bear Anxiety alone
Excessive self-blame and internal rumination instead of proactively seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Interpreting the husband's Silence as 'he hates me' 'he does not want this child'
Inferring the other party's negative intentions without evidence

positive_force: Has a certain degree of social support (has several close friends)
Willing to seek professional help and try recording thoughts and conducting reality testing
Able to recall and acknowledge that the husband tended to stay silent under pressure in the past, providing clues for alternative explanations
negative_force: Significant catastrophizing and mind-reading tendencies, jumping to conclusions easily in uncertain situations
Excessive personalization, attributing the negative meanings of others' behavior to one's own faults
Low tolerance for uncertainty, leading to Persistent anxiety, Sleep affected and Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety when the husband is Silent or distant, accompanied by catastrophic, mind-reading assumptions
antecedent: Husband remaining silent after learning of the pregnancy
Husband becoming more distant when pregnancy is discussed
Unable to get clear responses and information from the husband
target_behavior.core_reason: Seeing Silence as evidence of negative evaluation and rejection, influenced by catastrophizing, mind-reading and personalized thinking to try to control uncertainty
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain certainty through high vigilance and presuming the worst outcome, avoiding the risk of Being rejected
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep affected, Decreased attention, Persistent anxiety and Fear, blocked couple communication, intensified Relationship tension
